versions.content: The transmitter of an Offset Time Base (Time Master) shall perform the following steps to distribute the Offset Time Base: 1. Retrieve current Offset Time via StbM_GetOffset() 2. Write second portion of the Offset Time to OfsTimeSec 3. Write nanosecond portion of the Offset Time to OfsTimeNSec
